text:
elaine: hey team — quick design check for the Rules Inspector toolbar and ordering affordances. Pushing a small tweak to the right-hand inspector that adds a compact reorder control + a mini-simulate button. want short feedback on copy + keyboard behavior. (thread_ts=1876501234)

maria: looking now. can you drop a screenshot or gif of the flow? hard to picture just from words. :eyes:

elaine: pasted quick screen recording in the thread (link): https://app.redwood/mock/gif123 — core idea: replace full drag handle with a three-dot menu for mobile, keep drag handle for desktop hover, add chevrons for move up/down. the simulate button runs the current selection through the preview runner.

josh: curious about chevrons — do they maintain aria-hidden when disabled? if they remain focusable we need keyboard stop/start semantics.

nina: +1 on keyboard semantics. if chevrons are used for move up/down, they must be reachable via tab and announce position like "Rule 3 of 7" after move. Also need clear disabled state contrast.

elaine: good call. proposal: chevrons are focusable, have aria-labels: "move rule up" / "move rule down", and on action we call toast: "Moved 'Block payments from spammy domains' to position 2 of 7". Any copy nits?

rahul: toast copy is ok but maybe shorter: "Moved 'Block payments...' to #2 of 7" — less visual noise in the console. Also want an undo affordance: "Undo" action in toast that reverts order within 5s.

maria: agree on undo. For the inspector header, current label is "Rules Inspector" — suggest "Rule details" or "Rule editor"? "Inspector" confuses some PMs.

josh: "Rule editor" reads as editable — that's fine. but for some read-only customers (dedicated/private) the panel shows readonly state; maybe we need dynamic header: "Rule editor (read-only)" or append lock icon.

nina: accessibility: if header changes dynamically, ensure role=alert on the header update so assistive tech notices read-only toggles. Also keyboard shortcut to open/close the inspector — we have ctrl+. now in the repo, can we reuse?

elaine: yep reusing ctrl+. is fine. On validation messaging: current inline validation shows a red underline and tiny helper text "invalid condition". UX wants clearer guidance. proposed copy: "Condition invalid — add a comparator (equals, contains) or wrap in parentheses." Thoughts?

maria: prefer explicit guidance: "Condition invalid — expected 'attribute operator value', e.g. user.email contains 'example.com'". gives actionable example.

josh: technical ask: when preview simulation fails due to timeout, we currently show generic "preview failed". Can we surface error class e.g., "Preview timed out — try a smaller sample (50 rows)" and link to a troubleshooting doc.

elaine: yes. show error with suggested action and a link. we'll keep the base toast but also capture telemetry: preview_failure.reason = "timeout".

rahul: also thinking about batch sim vs single-route sim: add a tiny dropdown on the mini-simulate button: "Quick run" (single request), "Batch run" (50 samples). Keep default as quick. This helps reduce accidental long-running sims.

maria: microcopy for the dropdown: "Run sample" / "Run batch"? "Simulate" feels technical. "Preview results" maybe clearer to users.

elaine: ok new labels: button = "Preview"; dropdown items: "Preview (single)" and "Preview (batch — 50)". keep a tooltip: "Runs rules against sample traffic to preview routing decisions."

nina: keyboard & screen reader: ensure dropdown items are visible to screen readers and announce the sample size. e.g., "Preview batch, 50 samples". Also ensure focus trap doesn't happen inside the inspector when preview modal is open.

josh: implementation note: we should reuse the existing preview-runner API endpoint. it accepts payload: { rule_ids: [...], sample_size: 1 } — no changes needed server-side, just UI params. quick snippet for devs: ```json
{
  "rule_ids": ["r_12","r_13"],
  "sample_size": 1
}
```

elaine: thanks. last UX edge: move chevrons to be hidden for rules with priority pinned. we have pinned state for system rules. show a lock icon and tooltip: "Pinned — cannot reorder". good?

maria: yes, but visually the lock should be subtle so it doesn't compete with rule title. maybe 16px with 50% opacity.

rahul: question on analytics: track when users click Preview (single) vs Preview (batch) and if they use undo after reorder. add events: rule_reorder, reorder_undo, preview_run (size=1/50).

elaine: noted. final asks: design will push updated Figma frames by EOD, devs please glance tomorrow morning for any infra concerns. if no major blockers we'll ship to staging next Thursday.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: config branch "ruleflow/ui-mini-sim" created by maria. CI checks started. :rocket: (build 4821)

josh: I'll vet the keyboard interactions and follow up with a short PR checklist in the morning.

maria: pushing frames + microcopy now. thanks all! :heart:
